name: Wikipedia iOS
description: https://github.com/wikimedia/wikipedia-ios, the Wikipedia app: an .xcodeproj with Swift and Objective-C, local Swift packages (WMFData, WMFComponents, ...) and remote packages, built for the iOS Simulator; its git-ignored signing configuration is generated by the repository's own `scripts/setup_bundle_id ci`. Plain worktrees are set up as the project's README says and built with xcodebuild into the default DerivedData, as an agent would; xcfs is measured twice: slots driven by xcodebuild, and slots driven by the persistent build session. Swift packages are resolved by each side on its own (Xcode's global package cache is shared by both).

plain.build: xcodebuild build -project Wikipedia.xcodeproj -scheme Wikipedia -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

edits.name: edit a function body in the app target
edit a function body in a package ~300 files import (WMFData)
add a public declaration to that package
